description_en: Disables a custom IP address blocking policy for servers
description_zh: 关闭自定义的一台或者多台服务器上的IP拦截策略
name: DisableCustomBlockRecord

parameters.description_en:
The IP address that is specified in the policy.

> You can call the [DescribeCustomBlockRecords](~~DescribeCustomBlockRecords~~) operation to query the IP address.
